purpose: A centre-column vertical list for the round viewport: about 62 percent wide with a 64px edge fade, so rows never touch the invisible corners. The first primitive of the kit; Agents and Todo consume it.

states.recipe: The required empty node renders in place of the rows; an empty list must say why it is empty.
Rows scroll inside the masked column with pan-y touch and contained overscroll; the header stays fixed above.

antiPatterns.why: the touch target gets too small for a finger on glass; 96 is the default for that reason

antiPatterns.rule: Do not put the header inside the scroll area
antiPatterns.why: the title and count are the list's fixed frame; scrolling them away loses the context the round crop already squeezes
